summary: Round 29 — verified 3D direct MEP placement and drag on project 51845afe-0ba4-4c58-837b-e08808c32a6a. ALL P0 flows work: (1) violet banner 'Modalità inserimento <tool>' with data-testid='3d-placement-hint' appears when electrical/hvac/plumbing/gas tool is active and updates text per tool; (2) clicking the 3D canvas (data-testid='canvas-3d') triggers onPlace → toast '✓ Presa aggiunta in 3D · h=XXcm' / '✓ split aggiunto in 3D · h=XXcm' AND elec/hvac DOM counts increment by 1 (electrical 3→4, hvac 1→2); (3) banner disappears as expected when switching back to select tool. Backend GET /api/projects/<id> confirms the newly-placed electrical entry with required fields {id, x, y, wall_side: ±1, height_cm: 86, phase: 'fatto', type: 'presa'}. Save+reload persistence VERIFIED after dismissing toast overlay. ROOT-CAUSE bug found: the Sonner placement toast and the 'Salva' button share the top-right region and the toast container intercepts pointer events for ~4s, swallowing Save clicks made immediately after placement. Reproduction: place an MEP point → click Salva within a few seconds → NO PUT /api/projects fires and NO 'Progetto salvato' toast shown (silent failure for user). Workaround works after the placement toast auto-dismisses, but real users will likely hit this race.

action_items: FIX (HIGH): Reposition the Sonner Toaster (top-right) OR the Save button to avoid overlap. Recommended: configure Toaster position='bottom-right' in App.jsx, or add pointer-events: none on the toast container wrapper while keeping individual toast pointer-events-auto only where needed (Sonner supports this via the offset prop / className). Currently <li data-sonner-toast> intercepts clicks on the underlying Salva <button>.
Consider auto-saving after each onPlace placement (debounced ~500ms) so the user doesn't have to click Salva and run into the toast-overlap race.

rca of the issue: Bug: Save click silently no-ops right after MEP placement. RCA: <Toaster position='top-right'> (Sonner default) renders a fixed-position <section> that overlaps the absolute-right Salva <button> at x=1818-1904 / y=7-39 on 1920x1080. The active toast <li data-sonner-toast> within that section has pointer-events:auto and is rendered above the button, so Playwright (and real users) get their click delivered to the toast subtree rather than the button. The save() function therefore never runs — no PUT, no success/error toast. Mitigation: (1) move Toaster to position='bottom-right' or 'top-center'; (2) keep toast container's outer wrapper pointer-events:none and only re-enable on the dismiss-X (Sonner supports this pattern); (3) move Salva button slightly left or render it in a dedicated toolbar row below the toaster zone.
